fusions.name: Barbed Cast
fusions.desc: Casts a barbed thread at an enemy up to 6 tiles away, dealing 7 damage, up to 1.3 times as much at full reach, and slowing it by 30% for 2 seconds. It holds 4 charges, and a kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Gaffing Haul
fusions.desc: Hauls the target onto a thread hook for 28 damage that ignores resistances, leaving it 20% easier to wound for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Snagging Lining
fusions.desc: For 8 seconds, 50% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it.

fusions.name: Snagged Quarry
fusions.desc: Against enemies carrying your afflictions, you deal 10% more damage.
